entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-08-07
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • OpenAPI metadata/annotations added by [Attributes] are overwritten by XML Comments #63179
  • Add framework assemblies to OpenAPI XML generator #63176
    10.0-rc1
  • OpenAPI: Description Attribute is not applied to schema references #63175
  • File download endpoints incorrectly mapped as objects by built-in OpenAPI generator #63172
    Backlog
  • OpenAPI throws error MSB3073 and code 11 #63170

Closed

  • Fix `ProducesResponseType` on `IResult` handling in `OpenApiGenerator` and `ApiResponseTypeProvider` #57801
    10.0-rc1
  • Perf regression: kestrel-encoded-url #63167
  • Blazor reconnect CSS in .NET 10 has a syntax error #63159
  • [OpenApi] .NET 10, XML schema transformer applies property comments on referenced schema #61965
    10.0-rc1
  • A published blazor wasm app throws a serialization error "Unhandled exception rendering component: ConstructorContainsNullParameterNames" #52947
    10.0-rc1
  • Docker build fails with .NET 10 preview 7 due to package conflicts #63156
  • IIS Express fails to serve web apps in Visual Studio after Windows 11 24H2 update #63160
  • [Blazor] Add default IILink.Descriptors.xml to Components.WebAssembly #63098
    10.0-rc1
  • Kestrel HTTP/2 initial SETTINGS frame ignores defaults #63006
  • Asp.net core 8.0.17 breaks redirectURI #62354
  • [Known Build Error] `RequestPathBase_WithDoubleSlashes_Split` fails - IIS is not installed in the expected path #62924

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix OpenAPI schema generation for FileContentResult to use binary format #63180
    community-contribution, needs-area-label
  • OpenAPI: Apply descriptions from [Description] to the schema reference instead of the actual schema for properties #63177
    community-contribution, needs-area-label
  • Include a warning about host spoofing in xml #63174
    community-contribution, area-networking
  • Sync shared code from runtime #63169
    area-runtime
  • Support processing XML comments on [AsParameters] parameter #63166
    feature-openapi, area-minimal

Merged

  • Skip IResult in metadata if it implements IEndpointMetadataProvider #63157
    area-mvc, 10.0-rc1
  • Fix openapi schema xml comments handling for referenced schemas #62213
    community-contribution, feature-openapi, area-minimal, 10.0-rc1
  • [Blazor] Use DynamicDependency to preserve KeyValuePair for WebAssembly trimming #63099
    Attention: Shared Code Modified, 10.0-rc1
  • Update identity metrics with feedback #62982
    area-identity, 10.0-rc1
  • Auth metrics updates #63030
    area-auth, 10.0-rc1

Updated

  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #63109
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:, build-ops
  • Added usage of TimeProvider instead of DateTimeOffset #63042
    area-identity, community-contribution
  • Fix handling of enum default values in RDF and RDG #63086
    area-networking
  • Add [Obsolete] attribute to WebHost class and IWebHost interface, convert sample apps to HostBuilder pattern #63024
    Attention: Shared Code Modified
  • [Validation] Support generated `ValidatableTypeAttribute` for Blazor #63115
    area-infrastructure
  • Added string arrays to simple binding #63072
    community-contribution, pr: pending author input, area-minimal
  • Add passkey count and name length limits #62979
    area-blazor
  • [WIP] Update to wix5 #62885
    area-infrastructure
  • Deoptimize the exceptional cases in favor of optimal path #62997
    area-blazor
  • [Blazor] Add version-based cache busting to dotnet.js import statements #63164
    Attention: Shared Code Modified
  • Added Culture persistence between Client and Server #63144
    area-blazor, 10.0-rc1
  • Add SkipValidationAttribute to Microsoft.Extensions.Validation #63103
    area-infrastructure
  • Update browser testing dependencies: Selenium 4.35.0, Playwright 1.55.0 #63094
    Attention: Shared Code Modified
